jcr_content.jcr:title: i-Chips IP00C341 - Video Processing Chip
jcr_content.jcr:description: Check out the i-Chips IP00C341, equipped with 4K quad input capabilities. This video processing chip delivers impressive visuals in many professional settings.
jcr_content.keywords: IP00C341, image processing LSI, advanced features, de-interlacer, scaler, warping, edge-blending, dual input images, 4K60Hz, independent resizing, Picture-in-Picture (PiP), Picture-out-Picture (PoP), warp table generator, real-time image processing, keystone correction, pin-cushion correction, PQ HDR, HLG HDR, 3DLUT, color management, vibrant color reproduction, projectors, laser TVs, monitors, professional video applications, impressive visuals.

textwithimage_1.text:
The IP00C341 is a powerful and versatile image processing LSI that offers a range of advanced features. This multi-functional video processing chip includes a de-interlacer, scaler, warping, and edge-blending circuitry. It supports dual input images up to 4K60Hz and provides independent enlargement, shrinking, and de-interlacing capabilities with Picture-in-Picture (PiP) and Picture-out-Picture (PoP) output images.

One of its notable features is the embedded warp table generator, which enables real-time image processing for horizontal and vertical keystone correction as well as pin-cushion correction. This ensures that the projected or displayed image maintains its proper shape and alignment.

text_1.text:
The i-Chips IP00C341 integrates high-performance functions like PQ and HLG HDR systems (10-bit) and 3DLUT for color management. This enables accurate and vibrant color reproduction, enhancing the visual quality of the output.

With its extensive capabilities, the IP00C341 is an excellent choice for a wide range of high-performance video applications. It finds applications in projectors, laser TVs, monitors, and other devices where superior image processing is required. Its advanced features make it a valuable video processing chip, delivering impressive visuals in various professional settings.

Input (4K60Hz 4-port）

  • RGB 30bit / YUV4:4:4 30bit / YUV4:2:0 30bit / YUV4:2:2 20bit / YUV4:2:2 10bit (BT656)
  • @V-by-One® HS 4Gbps, 8 lane 2-port
  • @LV-CMOS 166MHz, supporting dual (EVEN/ODD) and DDR inputs 4-port
  • 4K60Hz input up to 2-port

Output (4K60Hz 1-port）

  • RGB 30bit / YUV4:4:4 30bit / YUV4:2:2 20bit / YUV4:2:2 10bit (BT656) @V-by-One® HS 4Gbps, 8 lane 2-port

External Memory

  • DDR3-SDRAM 64bit PC1600 (4G/2G/1G x16) x4

Input/Output Sync/Asynchronous Behavior

  • Frame rate conversion
  • Tearing protection
  • External force synchronization
  • Genlock

De-Interlacer

  • Motion adaptive filter based on Y, U, V, YUV 4:2:2
  • All major cadences supported
  • Low latency processing

Scaler

  • Zoom/shrink 6-symbol programable FIR filter (10bit/pixel)
  • Embedded ROM (64set)

Noise Reduction

  • 3DNR (H,V,Temporal)
  • MPEG-NR (Mosquito/Block)
  • Chroma error filter

Bit Map OSD

  • 256 colors/High color OSD (64K colors)
  • Embedded font engine (65536 words)
  • Blinking and semi-transparent (4 colors OSD)
  • 90-degree rotation, OSD scroll
  • Serial flash to bitmap

Image Quality Control

  • Color management (full color gamma)
  • 3DLUT (4K60Hz 2-input supported)
  • Uniformity correction
  • Bias/Gain/Gamma correction
  • H edge enhancement (9symbol), V edge enhancement (5 to 9symbol)
  • Dithering for 10 or 8 bit output
  • Distortion Correction Mode
  • RGB common distortion correction mode
  • Distortion Correction Method
  • Coordinate correction look up table
  • Embedded warp table generator (keystone correction and pin cushion correction)
  • Load from external CPU or external serial flash
  • Distortion Correction Amount
  • Up to 45 degrees (horizontal/vertical)

Image Correction

  • Edge-blending
  • Mirror/flip image
  • 90 degree rotation
  • Overlay, alpha blending, color key blending

CPU Interface

  • 8-bit parallel/4-wire serial

xvYCC/Bt.2020

  • Fully supported

HDR Standard

  • SMPTE ST2084 (PQ) and HLG both methods supported (RGB 10-bit each)

Power Supply

  • 3.3V/1.5V/1.1V

Package

  • 684-pin BGA (0.8mm pitch), 27mm x 27mm
